Hey Lisa,

Just a quick note to say hi! I was out in the backyard this afternoon and noticed you've planted some beautiful flowers in front. They look really nice and add a bit of color to the street. I love how everything looks with them blooming there.

Hope you're doing well. Let me know if you need any help with them or if there's anything I can do to make it easier for you.

Take care!
Cheers,
[Your Name] 

P.S. I'll try to stop by and admire them more often from now on! 😊
